_comment: Snippet for OpenHands Settings → MCP → Add Server. Paste the `searchbox` object into your OpenHands MCP config (UI: Settings → MCP → Add Server). The URL resolves via llm-stack-net DNS from the OpenHands app container; for runtime sandboxes use http://host.docker.internal:8024/sse instead (see docs/openhands.md → Локальный MCP-search).

searchbox.description: Multi-engine search: SearXNG, Wikipedia/Wikidata, arXiv, GitHub, Hacker News, StackExchange, Crossref/OpenAlex, PyPI/NPM, DuckDuckGo. Default tool `search` fans out in parallel and returns a deduplicated round-robin merge.
